summary: (standards pass, r2 re-check of 1_1) The new call pattern still misses two shell forms of the same call: npm with an option before the subcommand (npm --loglevel=error whoami) and a command prefix (env FOO=1 npm whoami). Added before the ABSENT block of publish.yml at 4d987de81, both leave the checker at exit 0. Every form 1_1 named (bare, VAR=$(...), backticks, || true, && chain, if !) is now refused. Fix: match npm followed by any options and then whoami (npm(\s+-\S+)*\s+whoami), or treat any source line containing the word whoami outside an echo or printf as a call.
